summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_039 contract. The governance-stage wrapper delegates directly to the runtime adapter, resolves bounded targets into falsifiable structural archetypes, preserves an explicit anti-hallucination contract, and degrades non-operating targets to not-yet-modelable instead of inventing system conclusions.

findings: The implementation accepts the declared upstream target-definition, classification, facility-prior, observed field and source-register inputs, with the wrapper enforcing mapping-shaped input before runtime delegation.

The adapter emits the expected archetype-resolution surface: selected_archetype_id, selected_archetype_label, match_confidence, resolver_state, anti_hallucination_contract, dominant_variable_hypotheses and system_abstraction_seed.

Executable coverage confirms the documented core behaviors: NYC commercial office tower selection, manufacturing laminate resolution from process clues, non-operating target degradation, logistics and cold-chain generic fallbacks, and utility-heavy industrial selection.
The implementation stays within boundary: it emits governed archetypal priors and falsifiable variable hypotheses, not savings claims, redesign prescriptions or final decision outputs.

The anti_hallucination_contract explicitly carries selected_archetype_evidence_state, rule, allowed_use and prohibited_use fields, which keeps archetype outputs bounded to prior-generation responsibilities.
Each dominant-variable hypothesis is structured with variable, layer, dominance, evidence_state, confirmation path, falsification path and decision impact fields aligned with the technical schema.

The read-only governance-wrapper smoke check resolved One Vanderbilt to commercial_office_tower_nyc with match_confidence=high, selected_archetype_evidence_state=ARCHETYPAL_PRIOR and four dominant variables, matching the runtime contract.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Executable conformance evidence covered the principal structural-archetype branches: high-confidence building resolution, manufacturing specialization, inadmissible headquarters-style degradation and generic fallback paths. This is sufficient for conformance review because it exercises the archetype-selection and anti-hallucination surfaces described in test_spec.md and failure_modes_spec.md.
test_results.notes: Ran pytest -q on runtime-orchestrator/tests/test_structural_intelligence_archetype_engine.py with 6 passing tests. Also executed a read-only smoke invocation through artifacts/implementation/codebase/engine.py using the documented One Vanderbilt example shape and confirmed the wrapper returns the runtime adapter surface without forking structural logic.
